title: >x< App shutdown
description: If >x< suspects your app version is vulnerable to security threats, app security shutdown limits your app functionality. Update your app to the latest version to restore full access.

runs: If we suspect that the current version of your >x< app is vulnerable to security threats, you may experience an app security shutdown. When this happens, you’ll see a message prompting you to update your device’s >x< app to the latest version. While experiencing limited app functionality, you’ll remain logged in to your account, and can maintain access through x.com.
What to expect if your device’s >x< app experiences a security shutdown:
If you’re on >x< for iOS, you’ll continue to see notification previews that you’ve previously set up on your device. Trying to open a notification will send you to the
prompt. If you’re on >x< for Android, you won’t see notifications.
You’ll continue to receive email notifications that you’ve previously set up for your account. When you click a post embedded in your email notification you’ll see the
prompt before the post launches on x.com.
Attempting to open your >x< for iOS app redirects you to the
prompt. Your account is still accessible via x.com, and app functionality is fully restored after performing the update.
Trying to compose a post or send a direct message from any iOS app extension, redirects you to the

prompt. You’ll need to perform the update to regain access to these features from your app extensions. While the app is shutdown, you can still choose to post and send direct messages from your account via x.com.
